model.title: FAA SMS Compliance Review Act of 2026
model.meta: Commerce, Science, and Transportation Committee · Sen. Maria Cantwell (D-WA)

summary.text: The bill would create an independent expert panel tasked with reviewing the Federal Aviation Administration's safety practices and recommending how the agency should implement a comprehensive safety management system across all of its operations.
